title: Deformation Theory of Monoid Schemes II: Precartesian Coextensions of Commutative Monoids
summary: This paper is a continuation of arXiv:2606.17088, where I studied precartesian coextensions of commutative monoids by systems of abelian groups. In this paper, we generalise it to study coextensions by systems of commutative monoids. Among other things, we showcase that this version is able to simultaneously generalise Leech's version of coextensions and Redei's version, also called Schreier coextensions.
